Now I'm listing the remaining H6 ids for the math subsets, algebra, counting and probability, geometry, intermediate algebra, number theory, and prealgebra.

I'm going to combine H6 and H7 into a single 512-item edited pass, then run H8+H9 and H10 separately, which cuts the passes from five to three and leaves four for other checks.

I'm planning to run BW on H6 and H7 together as one 512-item pass, then H8 and H9 as another, and H10 on its own, which would leave a few passes spare for confirmations on new sets. Before any of that, I need to restore C and re-run the analysis, then generate and print the ids for H11 through H14.

Next I'm setting up the BW pass on H6 and H7 together as one 512-item run with n=1, since the edited set allows that many.

A clear shortfall would mean the indirect layer-23 route of the full column matters more on fresh problems.
